# Cleveland Clinic Journal of Medicine

> A peer-reviewed medical journal publishing clinical research, case studies, and continuing education for healthcare professionals.

CCJM is a leading medical publication from Cleveland Clinic featuring original research, clinical cases, and CME/MOC continuing education with AMA PRA Category 1 Credit. The journal covers diverse medical specialties including cardiology, nephrology, rheumatology, and hematology.

## Key Topics

- peer-reviewed medical journal
- continuing education (CME/MOC)
- clinical cases and trials
- cardiovascular disease
- kidney disease
- rheumatology
- hemolytic anemia
- IgA nephropathy
- manuscript submission
- medical education
- clinical topics
- AMA PRA Category 1 Credit
- medical specialties
- article types
- peer review process

## Journal Content & Issues

- [Cleveland Clinic Journal of Medicine](https://www.ccjm.org): Homepage for Cleveland Clinic Journal of Medicine peer-reviewed medical journal
- [Table of Contents — March 01, 2026, 93 (3)](https://www.ccjm.org/content/current): Current issue table of contents with clinical cases and medical education
- [Published Ahead of Print](https://www.ccjm.org/content/early/recent): Recently published articles on COVID-19, vaccination, and clinical updates
- [Supplements](https://www.ccjm.org/content/supplemental): Supplemental issues covering CME articles on clinical topics
- [Archive of all online content](https://www.ccjm.org/content/by/year): Journal archive browsable by year with historical publications

## Continuing Education & CME

- [CME/MOC](https://www.ccjm.org/content/latest-articles-cmemoc): CME/MOC continuing education articles with AMA PRA Category 1 Credit
- [Calendar](https://www.ccjm.org/content/cmemoc-calendar): Calendar of CME events, conferences, and continuing education activities

## Content Organization & Specialties

- [Article Type](https://www.ccjm.org/content/article-type): Guide to article types and content categories in the journal
- [Specialty](https://www.ccjm.org/collection): Medical specialties directory organizing journal content by specialty

## For Authors & Reviewers

- [Manuscript Submission](https://www.ccjm.org/content/manuscript-submission): Guidelines for manuscript submission and peer review process
- [Authors & Reviewers](https://www.ccjm.org/content/authors-reviewers): Instructions for authors and peer reviewers on editorial process

## About & Information

- [About CCJM](https://www.ccjm.org/content/about-ccjm): About page describing journal mission, editorial board, and indexing
- [Subscriptions](https://www.ccjm.org/content/subscriptions): Journal subscription rates, pricing, and subscription management
- [Contact Us](https://www.ccjm.org/content/contact-us): Contact information for editorial team, subscriptions, and advertising

## Expert Interviews & Conference Coverage

- [Conversations with Leaders](https://www.ccjm.org/page/conversations): Video series with expert interviews on clinical topics and medical leadership
- [Conference Coverage](https://www.ccjm.org/content/acc-2020): ACC cardiology conference coverage with clinical trial findings
- [Kidney Week 2025](https://www.ccjm.org/page/asn-2025): Kidney Week 2025 conference summary on diabetes and kidney disease
- [ACR Convergence 2025](https://www.ccjm.org/page/acr-2025): ACR Convergence 2025 coverage on rheumatology and autoimmune diseases
